page.help: Write your server rules once. Members can read them on a web page, and when someone is punished, the private message (DM) they get can name the rule they broke and link to it.

list.title: Rules
list.count: {count} of {max} rules. The numbers follow the order in this list.
list.pageNoSite: Members see them at /rules on the website. The website address is not set up yet, so punishment messages name the rule without a link.
list.empty: No rules yet. Until you add some, the web page says the server has not published its rules.
list.deleteConfirm: Delete rule {number} ("{title}")? Rules after it move up one number, and reasons linked to it are unlinked.

rule.title: Title
rule.titleHelp: A short name for the rule, on one line.
rule.textHelp: Optional. Explain the rule in more detail. Line breaks are kept on the web page.
rule.consequenceHelp: Optional. What happens when someone breaks the rule, like "Warning" or "1-hour mute". It is only shown to members and to moderators as a reminder. It never punishes anyone by itself.
rule.full: The server has {max} rules, the most there can be. Delete one to add another.

library.title: Add from the library
library.help: Ready-made rules you can add with one click. You can edit or delete them afterwards like any other rule.
library.more: Adding a rule also links its reason (used by /enforcements) to it, unless that reason already points to another rule. Rules you already added show as Added.

links.title: Reasons linked to rules
links.help: Moderators pick a reason when they punish someone with /enforcements. Link a reason to a rule here, and the member's private message names that rule, like "Rule 3: No spam", with a link to it. The moderator also sees the rule and its consequence before confirming. Reasons a moderator types in by hand never name a rule.
links.empty: Add a rule first. Then each reason can point to one.

design.channelHelp: Where the rules are posted, usually a channel like #rules that only staff can write in.
design.title: Title
design.titleHelp: The bold line at the top of the post. Leave empty for no title.
design.colourHelp: The coloured edge on the left of the post.
design.hexHelp: A # and six letters or numbers. When filled in, it is used instead of the colour above.
design.introHelp: Optional text above the rules, for example a short welcome.
design.footerHelp: Optional small text at the bottom, for example "Breaking a rule can lead to a warning, mute or ban."
design.layoutHelp: A numbered list reads like a document. One box per rule puts each rule in its own block with its title in bold.
design.bannerUrlHelp: Optional. A wide picture shown above the rules. A link that starts with https://, or upload a file below.
design.thumbnailUrlHelp: Optional. A small picture in the top right corner of the post. A link that starts with https://, or upload a file below.

image.onlyDiscord: (only pictures stored on Discord can be shown here)
image.stored: Uploaded file: a copy is kept in {where}. Do not delete that message, because Mewvo loads the picture from it when it posts the rules.

banner.title: Banner
banner.uploadLabel: Upload a banner (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to {mb} MB)
banner.uploadHint: Replaces the banner link. Mewvo keeps a copy in your main log channel and attaches the picture to the rules post.
banner.removeConfirm: Remove the banner? The posted rules keep it until you update them.
banner.uploaded: Banner uploaded. A copy is kept in {where}. Do not delete that message.

thumbnail.title: Thumbnail
thumbnail.uploadLabel: Upload a thumbnail (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to {mb} MB)
thumbnail.uploadHint: Replaces the thumbnail link. Mewvo keeps a copy in your main log channel and attaches the picture to the rules post.
thumbnail.removeConfirm: Remove the thumbnail? The posted rules keep it until you update them.
thumbnail.uploaded: Thumbnail uploaded. A copy is kept in {where}. Do not delete that message.

preview.empty: Add a rule first. The preview shows here once there is something to post.
preview.note: An approximation of how Discord shows it. Mentions in the text never ping anyone.

post.help: Post your rules in a Discord channel as a styled message, and update that message when the rules change.
post.more: Save the design first, check the preview, then post. Posting and updating need Administrator. Mentions in the rules never ping anyone. In Discord, /rules post, /rules update and /rules preview do the same with this design.
post.title: Post
post.noChannel: Pick a channel in the design above and save it. Then you can post the rules.
post.channelGone: The saved channel no longer exists. Pick another one and save the design.
post.confirmAgain: Post the rules in #{channel} as a new copy? The earlier post stays where it is. To change it instead, use Update posted message.
post.notPosted: The rules have not been posted from here yet.
post.moved: Update changes that post. To move the rules to the new channel, post them there.
post.updateConfirm: Change the posted rules to the current rules and design?

error.tooLong: {label} is too long: at most {max} characters (you wrote {length}).
error.titleOneLine: The title must be one line.
error.ruleGone: That rule no longer exists. Reload the page.
error.colourHex: Colour: write a colour code like #9B59B6, or leave it empty and pick from the list.
error.full: The server already has {max} rules. Delete one first.
error.libraryGone: That library rule does not exist. Reload the page.
error.alreadyFirst: Rule {number} is already the first one.
error.alreadyLast: Rule {number} is already the last one.
error.linkGone: {reason}: that rule no longer exists. Reload the page.
error.postNoChannel: Pick a channel in the design and save it first. Nothing was posted.
error.postChannelGone: The saved channel no longer exists. Pick another one and save the design. Nothing was posted.
error.postRefused: Discord refused the post. Nothing was posted.
error.notPosted: The rules have not been posted yet. Use Post first.
error.updateRefused: Discord refused the update. Some messages may already show the new rules. Try Update posted message again.

action.reasonLinked: The reason "{reason}" now points to it.
action.designSaved: Design saved. Check the preview, then post or update.
action.updated: The posted rules in #{channel} were updated.
action.updatedNoChannel: The posted rules in the channel were updated.
